edbDesc: Differential buoyancy forces which cause convection in gravity fields may result from sources of density variations in fluids other than those produced by heat, such as variable composition. For example, diffusion of a source of dry salt downward into wet soil assisted by the mechanism of the fact that saline is heavier than fresh water.
title: Gravitational Convection (non heat)
pickWhy: Convection driven by density differences from dissolved substances rather than heat is a variant of convection; canonical entry is in another batch.
